plugins.name: project-development-skills
plugins.description: A coordinator-first development bundle: project-development-mindset routes to one specialist at a time, while brainstorm-first remains an independent pre-implementation decision workflow.
defaultPrompts: Use brainstorm-first independently for a pre-implementation decision phase; otherwise start with project-development-mindset and route to at most one specialist for the current primary concern.
Apply project-development-skills to review this repository and select only the primary workflow for the current phase.
Use project-development-skills to plan documentation and delivery without activating an opt-in workflow unless the user requests or accepts it.

plugins.name: laravel-app-skills
plugins.description: Version-exclusive Laravel 11/12 and Laravel 13 implementation guidance, coordinator-routed when project-development-mindset is available and directly usable when installed alone.
defaultPrompts: Inspect the installed or target laravel/framework major, then use exactly one matching Laravel guideline skill for this project task.
Apply laravel-app-skills to review this repository without loading both Laravel version skills.
